name: Rendery3D
description_en:
Rendery3D builds ecommerce listing-image workflows from existing product photographs. It proposes a shot plan, generates hero/lifestyle/detail assets and adds listing-copy or A+ content tools.

The site emphasizes a 3D-rendered aesthetic. This research did not establish delivery of editable three-dimensional geometry or a physically accurate product model; assess the exported images and product fidelity instead of assuming a CAD/rendering workflow.
description_zh:
Rendery3D 从现有商品照构建电商图片流程，规划镜头，生成主图、生活场景和细节，另有文案/A+ 工具。

网站强调 3D 渲染观感，本文未确认可编辑三维几何或物理准确模型；应评估图片及商品保真，不能假定 CAD/渲染流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Prepare a coordinated image set from a product source.
core_features.explanation_zh: 从商品原图准备协调图片集。

core_features.explanation_en: Apply saved brand context or workspace-scoped reference styles.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用品牌上下文或工作空间参考风格。

en: Prepare a product-accurate hero/detail/lifestyle set for one SKU.
zh: 为单 SKU 准备真实准确主图/细节/生活场景。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Upload an authorized real-product photo, inspect the plan and each generated detail, then review marketplace export specs.
steps.zh: 上传授权真实商品照，核规划及每个细节，再审核平台导出规格。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual subscription with separate image-credit pools and active-plan topups.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Annual Seller $450/60 premium+100 standard credits monthly; Agency $3,990/600+600, custom Aggregator. Five trial premium credits; active-plan topups $50/100 promotional total or $200/450. Rollover and plan naming need confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 年 Seller $450/月高级60+标准100；Agency $3,990/600+600，Aggregator 定制。试用高级5；付费有效时充值 $50/促总100 或 $200/450。结转及套餐名待核。

sources.title: Rendery3D - AI-Powered Product Listing Images for E-commerce
sources.research_notes_en: AI product-listing image sets with shot planning, brand styles, upscaling and A+ content; 3D-rendered look not demonstrated geometry asset.

sources.title: Pricing - Rendery3D
sources.research_notes_en: Annual Seller $450/Agency $3990, separate premium/standard credits, free five-credit try and active-plan topups; entitlement naming inconsistencies.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Preserve the product before styling the scene
sections.title_zh: 先保商品真实，再设计场景
sections.en: For an illustrative cosmetics listing, compare label text, package size, cap, color and included accessories with the real item in every image. A generated infographic must use verified specifications rather than invented benefits. Logo-safe and conversion claims are vendor promises, not measured accuracy or sales results.
sections.zh: 例如化妆品列表，应逐图对照真实标签、包装尺寸、盖、色及配件。信息图须用已核规格，不能编功效。标志安全和转化宣传只是厂商主张，非测量准确率或销售结果。

sections.title_en: Separate premium and standard credit budgets
sections.title_zh: 分开高级及标准额度预算
sections.en: Annual Seller is $450 with sixty premium and one hundred standard credits/month; Agency $3,990 with six hundred of each, up to ten client workspaces and five seats. Aggregator is custom with larger allowances. Free gives five premium credits to try. Approximate listings and ten-credit examples are not a guaranteed cost for every operation. Topups require an active paid plan.
sections.zh: Seller 年 $450，月高级 60/标准 100；Agency 年 $3,990，两种各 600、最多 10 客户空间/5 席；Aggregator 定制。免费试 5 高级额度，估算列表数/10 额度示例不保证每操作成本，充值需有效付费套餐。

sections.title_en: Use references without importing competitors’ claims
sections.title_zh: 参考风格但不导入竞品主张
sections.en: Custom Preset describes six to nine listing references and a workspace-scoped style system, with extraction consuming standard credits. Use authorized references and inspect whether text or protected branding is reproduced. The homepage calls this Pro+ while pricing assigns it to Seller; confirm current entitlement and whether rollover applies only to promotional credits or all balances.
sections.zh: Custom Preset 称 6–9 列表参考及工作空间风格，提取消耗标准额。应授权参考并核是否重现文字/品牌；首页称 Pro+ 而价格列 Seller，需确认现权益及结转仅促销还是全部。

sections.title_en: Validate marketplace exports and source-to-output mapping
sections.title_zh: 核平台导出及原图到结果映射
sections.en: Evaluate one real SKU and inspect crop, dimensions, compression and A+ modules against current marketplace requirements. Keep human approval before upload. No generation, 4K upscale, listing publication, API, seat control or credit transaction was tested. Refund, exact export formats, data terms and source licensing remain unverified.
sections.zh: 应单 SKU 评估裁切、尺寸、压缩及 A+ 是否符合现平台要求，上传前人工批准。本文未测生成、4K、发布、API、席位或扣额；退款、精确格式、数据及源码许可未核。

research_gaps: No generation, 3D geometry, product fidelity, credit use, marketplace publication or API tested.
Pro+/Seller mapping, rollover/refund, output rights, data retention, license and self-hosting unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
